catalogue_source: City of Toronto AIC FeatureServer layer 60

current_transport_contract.browser_javascript_observation: Current Toronto AIC JavaScript POSTs numeric folderRsn to the two api.toronto.ca/aic read endpoints and sends a browser-generated g-recaptcha-response header.
current_transport_contract.server_probe_result: No-token, blank-token and fake-token probes returned HTTP 400 for both read endpoints.
current_transport_contract.legacy_transport_result: The stored legacy secure.toronto.ca/AIC encrypted URLs returned HTTP 403 for almost all current applications in the attempted corpus partitions.

representative_invalid_partition.interpretation: This partition is retained only as transport diagnostics and is not counted as document-corpus coverage.

decision.reason: The current public supporting-document API is guarded by reCAPTCHA. TowerSignal will not defeat or bypass that anti-bot/access control for bulk extraction.
next_permitted_paths: City-provided documented bulk/API access that does not require bypassing reCAPTCHA
written City permission or data feed
manual review of specific applications for prospect/account verification
other open-licensed City documents already exposed outside the reCAPTCHA-gated AIC attachment API

coverage_semantics.warning: Zero parsed AIC documents is not evidence that applications have no supporting documents.
